'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good day to you, soldier. Though what's so good about it? You know what a wise man once said? "People were made to torment one another". When I first read that, I thought it couldn't be true. Now I remember those words, and my heart aches. We've got a new gang stirring up trouble in the city. I sent one of my men to talk to them, to try and bring them to their senses. They sent his head back to me. The letter I had asked him to deliver, they stuffed it into his mouth... They're not from around here. All of them came out of USEC, though they've long since turned their backs on their own. They need to be tracked down and wiped out, every last one of them. This is our land. There'll be no more talking with them.}}

==Objectives==
* Locate and eliminate [[Knight]] (in one raid)
* Locate and eliminate [[Big Pipe]] (in one raid)
* Locate and eliminate [[Birdeye]] (in one raid)

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Covert Movement|Covert Movement skill]] levels
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[S I C C organizational pouch]]
{{quote|Don't think about your hands getting bloody again, soldier. Think that you have cleared this land of the wicked.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill [[Knight]], [[Big Pipe]] and [[Birdeye]].
